name: Customer relationship
desired_outcome: Customers get lasting value from Ledgerly and choose to stay

name: Become and remain a Ledgerly customer
trigger: Business starts looking for an invoicing service
desired_outcome: The business invoices reliably through Ledgerly for as long as it needs to

name: Choose an invoicing service
trigger: Current way of invoicing becomes too slow or error-prone
end_boundary: Admin has committed to a service or given up looking
desired_outcome: Admin commits to a service they believe fits how the business keeps its books

name: Get the team invoicing in the service
trigger: Contract signed for a plan with 3 or more seats
end_boundary: Team sends its real invoices through Ledgerly as its normal way of working and the admin has stopped checking postings in the ledger by hand
desired_outcome: The team sends its real invoices through Ledgerly and the admin trusts that they land correctly in the books

name: Get the team invoicing in the service (target)
trigger: Contract signed for a plan with 3 or more seats
end_boundary: Team sends its real invoices through Ledgerly as its normal way of working and the admin has stopped checking postings in the ledger by hand
desired_outcome: Same actor outcome as the current journey, reached without team start waiting on accounting set-up

name: Get the team invoicing in the service (transitional Q1 2027)
trigger: Contract signed for a plan with 3 or more seats
end_boundary: Team sends its real invoices through Ledgerly as its normal way of working and the admin has stopped checking postings in the ledger by hand
desired_outcome: Same actor outcome; accountant review and first-invoice verification in place, team start still follows ledger set-up

name: Decide whether to keep the service
trigger: Renewal notice 60 days before term end
end_boundary: Admin has renewed or has decided to leave
desired_outcome: Admin renews because the service has become part of how the business runs

name: Get a new customer account live
trigger: Qualifying account requests a set-up session
end_boundary: Specialist hands the account back with no open set-up blocker
desired_outcome: Specialist resolves the account's set-up blockers in one session without rework
